answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 41329 Country: India Title: What is kashf and Elm-e-Najum, please explain in detail Question: (1) What is kashf and Elm-e-Najum, please explain in detail? (2) I like to become an Alim. Now my age is 19 and I am doing my B.Com final year but I do not like to study this nasty world education I hate it so I like to discontinue my final year and like to join in Deoband madrasa. I want to study only in Deoband madrasa, please help me. My parents are not allowing me to discontinue, daily fight in home. Please I want to study in Deoband and want to become Alim like Maulana Iliyas Ji (Rahmathullahi alaih). College and coeducation is haram, haram, haram. (3) I got Maulana Iliyas Ji (Rahmathullahi alaih) in my dream. I was standing near his grave. His grave was in a garden filled with flowers. I was standing near grave he came out from grave wearing white amamah, aba, and made musafaha with me and said say salam to ummah and went again in grave then I saw myself in between the garden and on the other side sum people were black rubbish sum huge giants beating that people in chains. Answer ID: 41329 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1747/B=390/TB=1433) (1) Your intention is very blessed and pure. Get the necessary education of the holy Quran and Hadith and become good Alim and preacher of Islam. The worldly education is merely for filling the stomach. In this education, there is no place for the hereafter, religion, moral etc. (2) It is hoped that you shall get religious benefit from Hadhrat Maulana Ilyas (RA) and you would become the preacher of deen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
